title: Mac native portability
objective: Make native compiler identity, sanitizer lifecycle witnesses, and dense-prime timing validation robust on real Apple systems without weakening required-native, sanitizer, absolute-performance, or legacy-relative gates.

oracles: Required-native execution across a lexical /var alias matches the compiled physical source identity.
Darwin sanitizer witnesses retain AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer while disabling only unsupported LeakSanitizer detection.
Dense-prime structural timing retains absolute and legacy-relative bounds under robust repeated sampling.

handoff.summary: At independently approved source a48bd53610d6be40bc92f47aee7b117f6b8959a1, development native compilation and runtime registration now use the same physical source identity across lexical filesystem aliases, with a required-native symlink regression proving manifest, discovery-index, and runtime agreement. Every affected FLINT and M4RI lifecycle witness uses the shared platform capability environment: Apple retains AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer while disabling only unsupported LeakSanitizer detection, and a repository ratchet rejects new raw leak-enabling assignments across test, tools/ffi, and package-test trees. Dense-prime unpack scaling now uses seven order-balanced paired batches and their median while retaining the prior absolute, legacy-relative, and 5x scaling gates. Exact Linux x64 focused, portable, architecture, strict-Python, complete Node-manifest, native package, lifecycle-fuzz, and performance gates pass. A physical Apple M1 Max running macOS 26.4 passed the required-native alias plus sanitizer/M4RI witness and dense-prime structural timing at the exact source fingerprint. Native Windows x64 passed the non-Darwin sanitizer-policy ratchet at the same source fingerprint after the clean checkout was built. The unchanged test/native-kernel.cjs claim identified in review has been removed.
risks: The exact pnpm test:changed receipt remains failed and must not be represented as an aggregate pass. Its build, architecture, 447/447 unit, compiler, 439-pass/3-skip integration, complete native, sanitizer, and absolute-performance stages passed; docs:check then failed because inherited website/reference-data.json provenance is stale, so the command stopped before test:cli. A generated-output comparison found docs/reference/api.md and both Prism assets byte-current; reference-data differs only in 75 line values, 29 start_line values, and one surrounding source excerpt, while reference.html differs only in the derived reference-data content hash. This lane changes none of src/baselib, docs/reference, website, or the reference-generation scripts relative to base db6258674e6f191b8187c31e2231a45c73a5c5c6. The separate pnpm test:cli receipt passes 886 tests with 3 intentional skips and closes only the final suite that test:changed did not reach; it does not clear the stale-docs failure.

The first native Windows x64 ratchet attempt is retained as a failed receipt: the fresh checkout had no dist/tools/compiler.js. After initializing its submodules and completing the exact-source build, the identical ratchet command passed; no production assertion failed in the first attempt.

A separate Linux arm64 host was not exercised. The changed implementation has Darwin-versus-non-Darwin behavior but no Linux architecture branch; Linux x64 covers the non-Darwin native path and the physical Apple M1 Max covers arm64 plus the original Darwin failure mode.
next_steps: Refresh the inherited website reference provenance on the consolidated integration baseline and rerun docs:check plus test:changed so the aggregate receipt becomes green without expanding this lane's claims.
Integrate the exact reviewed source and closure, then perform the frozen macOS release rehearsal, signing, notarization, and final artifact acceptance downstream.
